detail.command:
set -e
npm run typecheck
npm run build
printf '
=== COURSE FILES ===
'
find src/courses/data -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.ts' -print | sort
printf '
=== HOLE COUNTS ===
'
for spec in 'neon-city.ts neon' 'haunted-mansion.ts haunted' 'space-station.ts space'; do set -- $spec; n=$(grep -o "id:'$2-[0-9][0-9]'" "src/courses/data/$1" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); printf '%s: %s
' "$1" "$n"; test "$n" = 9; done
printf '
=== DUPLICATE HOLE IDS ===
'
ids=$(grep -ho "id:'\(neon\|haunted\|space\)-[0-9][0-9]'" src/courses/data/*.ts | sort); test "$(printf '%s
' "$ids" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 27; test "$(printf '%s
' "$ids" | uniq | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 27; echo none
printf '
=== STATUS ===
'
git status --short
printf '
=== CHANGED PATHS ===
'
git status --short | awk '{print $2}'
